seo.title: Men's Facials in Carlsbad, NM | Divinely Faded
seo.description: Men's facials in Carlsbad, NM at Divinely Faded: the Express and Deluxe Facial, with steam, massage and moisturizer in the barber chair.

paragraphs: Two facials, both done right here in the barber chair. You don't need a spa appointment or a separate trip across town to take care of your skin. You lean back, I handle the rest.

alt.steam-facial: Warm steam directed at a reclined client's face during a men's facial
alt.facial-hot-towel-massage: Facial massage at the temples of a reclined, bearded client

items.title: Express Facial
items.body: Facial massage, warm steam, a deep cleanse, gentle exfoliation and a hydrating moisturizer. A full reset that fits into a short window.

items.title: Deluxe Facial
items.body: Facial massage, warm steam, gentle exfoliation and a hydrating moisturizer, plus advanced skin treatments and an anti-aging serum. The one to book when you want more than a refresh.

blocks.heading: What it feels like.
blocks.lead: Nothing to do but sit back.
paragraphs: You lean back for this one. Both facials include a massage across the face and temples, like the one in the photo above, warm steam aimed at the face, gentle exfoliation and a hydrating moisturizer.
The Express adds a deep cleanse. The Deluxe adds advanced skin treatments and an anti-aging serum.
The two photos at the top show both halves of it: warm steam aimed at a reclined client's face, and a massage worked in at the temples.

blocks.heading: Short on time?
paragraphs: The Express Facial takes {{minutes:express-facial}}. The Deluxe takes {{minutes:deluxe-facial}} and costs {{price:deluxe-facial}}, and that's where the advanced treatments and the serum come in.
If you mostly want the steam and the hot towels with your haircut, look at the Luxury Grooming Experience on the haircuts page. Facial steam and dual hot towels are already built into it.
Either facial books on Booksy like any other appointment. Payment comes after the facial, and skipping the appointment without notice may carry a cancellation fee.

items.q: What's the difference between the Express and the Deluxe?
items.a: Both include facial massage, warm steam, gentle exfoliation and a hydrating moisturizer. The Express includes a deep cleanse, while the Deluxe includes advanced skin treatments and an anti-aging serum.

items.q: Does any haircut come with facial steam?
items.a: Yes. The Luxury Grooming Experience includes facial steam and dual hot towels with the cut.
